fields.label: How this record works
fields.text:
ONE ENTRY IS ONE DESIGNATION. Make a new entry whenever the primary or the substitute changes, and at least once a year to confirm the designation in force. Earlier entries are never edited: they are the history of who held the authority, and when.

THIS RECORD NAMES PEOPLE SO THE DOCUMENTS DO NOT HAVE TO. FSQM-004 and every other controlled document name the position, not the person. The individuals holding it are recorded here, so a change of personnel is a new entry rather than a document revision.

WHO SIGNS WHAT. Each acknowledgement is signed by the person named, in their own login. Only senior site management can sign the designation itself, and the app enforces that. A staff login can edit only an entry it started, so the person designated primary should start this entry and sign first; senior site management then completes and submits it.

SENIOR SITE MANAGEMENT MAY ALSO BE THE SUBSTITUTE. 2.1.1.4 makes the designation senior site management's act and does not stop it naming itself, and in a small site it often has to. Where that is the case the same person signs both, and the record should show it as it is.

fields.label: What is designated
fields.text:
The primary and the substitute SQF Practitioner are given the responsibility and authority to:
i. oversee how the SQF System is developed, put in place, reviewed and kept up;
ii. act to protect the integrity of the SQF System; and
iii. make sure the people who need it are told what keeps the SQF System working.

The substitute holds the same responsibility and authority whenever the primary is absent. The duties of the post are set out in FSQM-004. This record confers the authority; it does not restate the job.

fields.label: Both designees have been told of this responsibility and authority
How to answer
fields.text:
Answer each point for the person named as primary. PENDING IS AN HONEST ANSWER and is expected while training is outstanding - it is not a failure, and writing Met to avoid it would be.

Point iii means a recognised external HACCP course with a certificate. File the certificate on FRM-952 Training Competency Verification Record and note the reference below. The internal TRN-005 training module is awareness training for the floor and is not a HACCP course.
